selected_sae_features.label: Short glycine/alanine-rich membrane helices
selected_sae_features.description: Short, glycine/alanine-rich hydrophobic alpha-helices that insert into or span membranes—including single-pass transmembrane anchors, fusion peptides, and pore/translocation helices—frequently containing GxxxG/glycine‑zipper motifs used for helix packing.

selected_sae_features.label: Phage tail oligomerization interfaces
selected_sae_features.description: Oligomerization/assembly interface segments of phage tail–like spikes and tubes (tail tube/sheath, terminator, baseplate hub/junction; gp27–gp5/VgrG core), generalized to analogous interface patches in other large macromolecular assemblies (Type II/IV pili, fimbriae, flagellar rings, viral scaffolds, CRISPR RAMP filaments, and ribosomal S6)

selected_sae_features.label: Exposed low-complexity surfaces
selected_sae_features.description: Exposed regions on extracellular, virion, or secretory-pathway luminal proteins—often low-complexity and Ser/Thr‑rich/glycosylated—plus analogous exposed, repetitive or low‑complexity surfaces on large cytosolic assemblies (e.g., CRISPR/Cas backbones); excludes signal peptides, transmembranes, and short cytosolic tails.
